# Typography

Fonts: Inter for Latin, Noto Sans SC / 思源黑体 for Chinese, JetBrains Mono for code. Provide system fallbacks and verify font licenses before redistribution.

| Role | Desktop | Mobile | Weight | Line height |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| H1 | 48px | 36px | 700 | 1.15 |
| H2 | 32px | 28px | 650 | 1.2 |
| H3 | 24px | 22px | 600 | 1.3 |
| Body | 16px | 16px | 400 | 1.6 |
| Small | 14px | 14px | 400 | 1.5 |
| Caption | 12px | 12px | 400 | 1.4 |

Avoid tiny body copy and text embedded in raster images. Support browser text zoom to 200% without loss of functionality.
